headline: LLM agents automate reproduction, model building, and multi-stage inference in biology
label: Agentic Llm Biomedical Research
summary: Three April 2026 preprints pair agent-driven reproduction, autonomous model building, and a benchmark where the top pass rate is 33.2%.
synthesis: The common thread is an LLM embedded in an agentic loop that carries out multi-step computational work against explicit objectives rather than producing a single output. AblateCell reproduces single-cell perturbation prediction baselines (CPA, GEARS, BioLORD) and runs closed-loop ablations of repository components. AIDO.Builder autonomously constructs and iteratively refines biomedical ML pipelines from a task description and target metric. GeneBench shifts the emphasis to evaluation, testing AI agents on 103 multi-stage genomics and quantitative biology tasks, with a best pass rate of 33.2% (GPT-5.5 Pro). What is new is the combination of agent-driven reproduction, iterative model construction, and benchmarked multi-stage inference in biology. All three items are preprints.
